'''Tony Maravola''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 39 from Gurnee, Il. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Tony also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 4 in YJ Constructed Deck.<ref name="dc99yj12_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ12_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Constructed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001009054101/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ12_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
